name: @nexus/extension-halo
description: HALO - Local-first SidePanel utilities and explicit network tools

scripts.build: bun check-release-source-graph.ts && bun build.ts --analyze && bun finalize-release-payload.ts
scripts.build:prod: bun check-release-source-graph.ts && bun build.ts --analyze && bun ../../scripts/capture-retained-dependencies.ts halo --keep-analysis && bun ../../scripts/artifact-provenance.ts halo --keep-analysis && bun finalize-release-payload.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun test test/storage-settlement.spec.ts test/storage-ledger.spec.ts test/network-targets.spec.ts test/heavy-task-bounds.spec.ts test/library-reuse-admission.spec.ts test/identity-codecs.spec.ts test/extension-worker.spec.ts test/exif-reader.spec.ts test/mse-player.spec.ts test/smooth-scroll.spec.ts test/smooth-scroll-keyboard-contract.spec.ts test/build-runtime-surfaces.spec.ts test/context-menu-activation.spec.ts test/frame-tools-lazy.spec.ts test/hover-zoom-authority.spec.ts test/hover-zoom-lazy.spec.ts test/module-lifecycle.spec.ts test/module-cross-context-authority.spec.ts test/module-hydration-retry.spec.ts test/module-runtime-installation-gates.spec.ts test/user-scripts-readiness-races.spec.ts test/storage-change-bus-surfaces.spec.ts test/user-scripts-storage-authority.spec.ts test/user-scripts-storage-rejection-race.spec.ts test/markdown.spec.ts test/release-tooling.spec.ts test/stable-ui-identities.spec.ts test/storage-boundaries.spec.ts test/ui-interaction-semantics.spec.ts test/hot-path-lifecycle.spec.ts test/resource-provenance.spec.ts test/registry-generation.spec.ts test/bilibili-enhancer-contract.spec.ts test/release-admission-properties.spec.ts test/release-source-graph.spec.ts test/release-admission-build.spec.ts test/active-services-contract.spec.ts test/legacy-business-preservation.spec.ts test/theme-contrast.spec.ts test/deadline-jobs.spec.ts test/screenshot-target.spec.ts test/owned-async-task.spec.ts test/heavy-worker-tasks.spec.ts test/object-url-lifecycle.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser-chromium: bun run test:browser-chromium:fast && bun run test:performance
scripts.test:playwright: bun run build:prod && bunx playwright test test/*-playwright.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:browser-chromium:fast: bunx playwright test test/smooth-scroll-keyboard-playwright.spec.ts test/frame-tools-lazy-playwright.spec.ts test/hover-zoom-lazy-playwright.spec.ts test/sidepanel-runtime-playwright.spec.ts test/sidepanel-accessibility-playwright.spec.ts test/sidepanel-diagnostics-playwright.spec.ts --workers=1
